main_body: Shrine building with a large tiled roof and front wall
top_band: Teal-green sloped tile roof with ridge beam (rows 4 to 42)
evidence: The structure clearly shows a large sloped roof surface seen from above (rows 4-42) sitting over the vertical front wall and lintel (rows 43-78). A bright orange lintel edge at row 43 and dark shadow band at row 46 separate the top/roof from the recessed wall and doors.

style.evidence: The candidate matches the Beodeul reference standard well: the roof has 6 distinct teal-green value steps with individually shaded tile columns, plaster walls have subtle speckle texture, dark material-toned outlines are used, and doors feature rich lattice detailing.
